parsed.summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of loading the entire dataset into memory when accessing the `chunks` attribute for zarr-backed xarray datasets. The change is minimal and focused on the intended fix.

issues.description: The patch introduces a minor style inconsistency by using `zip(v.dims, v.encoding['chunks'])` instead of directly accessing `v.chunksizes`. This could be improved for consistency with existing code.
